messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: I want to know some tall buildings in New York City\nassistant: Sure, here is a list of tall buildings in New York City:\n1. One World Trade Center\n2. 432 Park Avenue\n3. Empire State Building\n4. Bank of America Tower\n5. Three World Trade Center\n6. Chrysler Building\n7. The New York Times Building\n8. 53W53\n9. One57\n10. Four World Trade Center\nuser: what is One World Trade Center?\nassistant: One World Trade Center is the main building of the rebuilt World Trade Center complex in Lower Manhattan, New York City. It is the second - tallest freestanding structure building in the Western Hemisphere, and the sixth - tallest in the world. It is also known as 1 World Trade Center, 1 WTC or Freedom Tower. One World Trade Center surpasses the height of Taipei 101, is the world 's tallest all - office building, and the fourth - tallest skyscraper in the world , behind the Burj Khalifa, Abraj Al Bait, and Shanghai Tower.\nuser: Who built the One World Trade Center and why?\nassistant: Daniel R. Tishman, along with his father John Tishman, led the construction team from Tishman Realty & Construction to build the One World Trade Center. It is built to memorialize the September 11 attacks and to rebuild the complex.\nuser: I want to know who owns it now and if all the spaces in the building are leased out.\nassistant: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey is the primary owner of One World Trade Center. Approximately 5 percent of the building's equity has been sold to the Durst Organization, a private real estate company. Not all the spaces in the building are leased. As of November 2014, the lease occupancy rate had increased to 62.8 percent.\nuser: How was the location of the One World Trade Center decided?\nassistant: The location of the One World Trade Center was originally planned to be on the east side of Lower Manhattan. However, due to disagreements between the New Jersey and New York state governments, which oversee the Port Authority, the location was shifted to the site of the H&M's Hudson Terminal on the Lower West Side of Manhattan after several meetings.\nuser: how many people exactly participated in this project?\nassistant: I do not have specific information on the exact number of people who participated in the construction of One World Trade Center. \nuser:  how much did it cost in the end comparing to the old original World Trade Center complex?",
    "answer": "The document says the original World Trade Center twin towers ultimately cost the Port Authority $900 million, compared with an initial estimate of $350 million. It does not provide the cost of the rebuilt One World Trade Center, so I can’t compare the two projects’ final costs. [S1] [S2]"
}
Output:

statements: The document states that the original World Trade Center twin towers ultimately cost the Port Authority $900 million.
The document states that the initial cost estimate for the original World Trade Center twin towers was $350 million.
The document does not provide the cost of the rebuilt One World Trade Center.
The final costs of the original World Trade Center twin towers and the rebuilt One World Trade Center cannot be compared using the information provided in the document.
